case.summary: Investigation SEN-001 was opened following a Sentinel sweep on card C07472-K1 belonging to customer C07472 due to an unusual device profile ring. Graph analysis confirmed a fraud verdict with a probability of 0.90 based on 5 independent signals, including two transactions totaling $265.85 routed through an anonymous proxy. The closed-case classifier scored transaction 3512563 at 0.74, while the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 was shared across multiple cards and linked to prior cases such as CASE-HHG-014 and CASE-SEN-001. Recommended actions include blocking card C07472-K1, creating a case, filing a report, monitoring connected cards, and escalating to an analyst under policies R1, R6, and R9.
